item.title: Holiday Season Arrives: The 100th Macy's Parade, the Tree and the Rockettes
item.description: The Rockefeller Center tree arrives Nov. 7, the Christmas Spectacular is underway at Radio City, and Macy's marches for the 100th time on Thanksgiving morning.

item.title: Dave Matthews Band Back at the Garden for Two Nights
item.description: Dave Matthews Band plays Madison Square Garden Nov. 12 and 13 on its Fall Tour 2026, with a different setlist each night.

item.title: New York Today and Tonight: Dudamel's Tosca, Dave Matthews at MSG
item.description: Friday, November 13: Gustavo Dudamel leads Tosca at 7:30 p.m. at Carnegie Hall, and Dave Matthews Band plays Madison Square Garden tonight.

item.title: Paul Taylor Dance Company Brings Three Premieres to Lincoln Center
item.description: Runs November 3 to 22 at the David H. Koch Theater, Lincoln Center, Upper West Side, with showtimes listed at boxoffice.dance.

item.title: Saint-Saëns's Samson et Dalila Comes to the Met on December 18
item.description: Friday, December 18 at 7 p.m. at the Metropolitan Opera House, Lincoln Center, Upper West Side; check metopera.org for casting.

item.title: LaGuardia Students Stage Godspell in Queens, Through November 22
item.description: Open dress rehearsal Wednesday, November 18 at 5 p.m.; performances through Sunday, November 22 at 2 p.m., LaGuardia Community College's Performing Arts Center, Long Island City, Queens.

item.title: Trinity Choir Pairs Marianna Martines With Mozart at Trinity Church
item.description: Wednesday, November 18 from 1 to 2 p.m. at Trinity Church, 89 Broadway, Lower Manhattan, in the Concerts at One series.

item.title: Sandbox Percussion Brings Steve Reich's Drumming to Trinity Church
item.description: Thursday, November 19 at 6:30 p.m. at Trinity Church, 89 Broadway, Lower Manhattan, with Sandbox Percussion and the students they have mentored.

item.title: Grand Bazaar's Autumn Bazaar Brings Makers and Vintage Sunday
item.description: Sunday, November 15 from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. at 100 West 77th Street at Columbus Avenue, Upper West Side.

item.title: NYBG's Holiday Train Show Runs Through January 10 in the Bronx
item.description: Opens Saturday, November 14, with timed entry from 10 a.m., at the Enid A. Haupt Conservatory, New York Botanical Garden, Bronx.

item.title: Frank Huang Plays Mendelssohn With the New York Philharmonic
item.description: Thursday, November 19 at 7:30 PM at David Geffen Hall in Lincoln Center, with further concerts on November 20 and 21.

item.title: Morton Feldman's For Philip Guston Fills the Met's Lehman Wing
item.description: Friday, November 13 from 3 to 7:30 PM in the Robert Lehman Wing at the Met on Fifth Avenue in the Upper East Side.

item.title: Glykeria and Kostas Ageris Sing in Manhattan on November 14
item.description: Saturday, November 14 at 9 PM in the Grand Ballroom at Manhattan Center in Midtown.

item.title: Harlem Gospel Choir Sings at the Blue Note on Sunday, November 22
item.description: Sunday, November 22 at 1:30 PM at the Blue Note jazz club in Greenwich Village.

item.title: Sitarist Rishab Rikhiram Sharma Plays Carnegie Hall on November 21
item.description: Saturday, November 21 at Stern Auditorium in Carnegie Hall, Midtown.

item.title: MasterVoices Celebrates Handel at Carnegie Hall on December 15
item.description: Tuesday, Dec. 15 at 7:30 p.m. in Carnegie Hall's Stern Auditorium in Midtown, Ted Sperling leads the MasterVoices Chorus and New York Baroque in a Handel holiday celebration.

item.title: Raúl Esparza Stars in Galileo, a New Broadway Musical at the Shubert Theatre
item.description: Previews begin Tuesday, Nov. 10, and the show opens Sunday, Dec. 6, at the Shubert Theatre in the Theater District.

item.title: Apollo's Fire and Soprano Jeanine De Bique Bring Baroque Music to Zankel Hall
item.description: Sunday, Nov. 15 at Zankel Hall in Carnegie Hall, Midtown, Jeannette Sorrell leads Apollo's Fire and soprano Jeanine De Bique; the start time is still to be confirmed.

item.title: Siena: The Art of Bronze Fills the Frick Through January 18
item.description: Nearly forty Sienese bronzes, including works by Donatello, are on view at the Frick Collection, 1 East 70th Street, through January 18, 2027.

item.title: Iris van Herpen: Sculpting the Senses at the Brooklyn Museum Through December 6
item.description: More than 140 haute couture works share the galleries at the Brooklyn Museum, 200 Eastern Parkway, in the designer's North American debut.

item.title: Lincoln in the Bardo Closes Its Metropolitan Opera Run on November 14
item.description: Missy Mazzoli's supernatural opera, based on George Saunders' novel, plays its last Met performances through Saturday, November 14.

item.title: JACK Quartet Plays Morton Feldman at The Met Cloisters on November 14
item.description: Saturday, November 14 at 2 PM in the Fuentidueña Chapel at The Met Cloisters, with the JACK Quartet and violinist Keir GoGwilt.

item.title: Mezzo-Soprano Rihab Chaieb Sings Songs From Arabic Poetry at Carnegie
item.description: Wednesday, November 18 at 7:30 PM in Weill Recital Hall at Carnegie Hall, with pianist Ammiel Bushakevitz.

item.title: Black Belt Eagle Scout and Joe Rainey at the Met on November 17
item.description: Tuesday, November 17 at 7 PM in the Grace Rainey Rogers Auditorium at The Met Fifth Avenue, 1000 Fifth Avenue.

item.title: Gustavo Dudamel Leads the New York Philharmonic in Tosca at Carnegie Hall
item.description: Friday, November 13 at 7:30 p.m. and Sunday, November 15 at 2 p.m., Stern Auditorium at Carnegie Hall in Midtown Manhattan.

item.title: Thomas Dunford and Léa Desandre: Baroque Arias at Weill Recital Hall
item.description: Tuesday, November 17, doors 7:30 PM, Weill Recital Hall at Carnegie Hall, Midtown.

item.title: Seven Guitars Begins Previews at Lincoln Center Theater Tonight
item.description: Previews begin Thursday, November 5 at the Mitzi E. Newhouse Theater, with opening night on Monday, November 23.

item.title: Salcedo's Latin Soul Sunday Afternoon at Kupferberg Center in Flushing
item.description: Sunday, November 15 at 3 PM in LeFrak Concert Hall, Kupferberg Center for the Arts, 65-30 Kissena Boulevard, Flushing.

item.title: New York Results: Hochul Wins, All Five City Proposals Pass
item.description: The AP projected Gov. Kathy Hochul's re-election over Bruce Blakeman, and city voters approved all five charter questions.

item.title: Yo-Yo Ma and Rhiannon Giddens Lead Silkroad Ensemble at Carnegie
item.description: Saturday, November 14 at 7 PM in Stern Auditorium, Carnegie Hall, Midtown: a 25th-anniversary night of world and classical music.
